lead.headline: Odunze scores 26.7 on your bench as Gibbs runs for 205
lead.deck: JuiceJam lead 65.6 to 14.9. Tuten missed Thursday too; Likely was limited again. Both Sunday fallbacks stand.
lead.body: Bad news first. Rome Odunze caught two touchdowns, the second the winner in Chicago's 38-35 win at Detroit, for 26.7 points — on your bench, while Matthew Golden had 4.9. The projection chose Golden, 16.7 to 10.9, and one week does not change that. Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 205 yards and three touchdowns for JuiceJam, who lead 65.6 to 14.9. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Thursday after missing Wednesday, and Isaiah Likely was limited again. George Pickens is playing Philadelphia now. Sunday's plan is unchanged: if Tuten sits, Jonathan Taylor starts; if Likely sits, add Kyle Pitts Sr. and drop Aaron Jones Sr. ESPN gives you 33%.
